_note: Internal reference baseline for the ablation ladder (not an official baseline): the plain model on our own training settings. ConvNeXt-Base with the crop and disease classifier heads trained with cross-entropy (label smoothing 0.1) only: SupCon weights 0 and no held-out pairs loss. Everything else is identical to Run 4 and to the SupCon-off control (two views, batch of 64 images, optimiser, 20-epoch schedule, validation protocol, final fit matched to the validation schedule). Ladder: this run, then + held-out pairs loss (supcon_ce_convnext_base_control_no_supcon, 70.71), then + SupCon (Run 4, 70.94). Close to a multi-task ConvNeXt baseline but not identical to config/multitask/Nat_multitask_convnext_base.json (batch 16 x 2 accumulation, warmup, clipping).
_result: Internal reference baseline. Test HM Top-1 66.39 / Top-5 93.04; seen 56.65, unseen 80.18 (calibrated); raw seen 72.4, raw unseen 6.8; 29.8% of seen images sent to unseen pairs; AUROC seen-versus-unseen 0.895. Epoch 5, gamma 6.75, validation HM 58.30 (per split 51.30 / 60.09 / 63.51). Ladder: CE-only 66.39 -> + held-out pairs loss (control) 70.71 (+4.3 on test; validation 58.30 -> 61.73, +3.4; seen-to-unseen 29.8% -> 21.1%; AUROC 0.895 -> 0.916) -> + SupCon (Run 4) 70.94 (+0.2). The held-out pairs loss gives a gain just above the noise of about 3 points on test and on validation; SupCon adds nothing. Caveats: one seed; the CE-only run chose epoch 5 against 17 (the earlier epoch ablation on the SupCon + CE model suggests the epoch itself explains under 1 point).

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base from timm, ImageNet-22k pretraining then 1k fine-tuning; drop_path_rate is stochastic depth. ce_dropout matches the baseline's head dropout.

input._note: Bicubic resizing, as ConvNeXt was pretrained.

augmentation._note: Same as the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline.

loss._note: CE only: SupCon weights 0, no pair_loss.

scoring._note: CHANGED: mode heads, the cross-entropy heads' log-probabilities. temperature is only used for the prototypes saved alongside.

optimizer._note: As the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline (lr_head also covers the projection and cross-entropy heads).

training._note: final_schedule match_validation as in Run 2. No saved validation grid is reused: stage 1 runs in full because the training loss changed.

runtime._note: grad_checkpointing: recompute backbone activations in the backward pass; identical gradients, less GPU memory, somewhat slower. Needed because ConvNeXt-Base with 128 views per step did not fit in 16 GB.
